reason: Okay, the duck socks are actually funny and my colleague would love them, but the birthday is coming up and there's no delivery date at all. I'm not paying €4.99 to wait for 99 strangers to also reserve before anything gets made.
objection: Why pay €4.99 just to reserve something that might never hit 100 reservations, with no idea when (or if) it ships? A gift that shows up 'eventually' isn't a gift.
would_change_my_mind: A real in-stock option or a guaranteed delivery date within a week or two, so I could actually give it on the birthday.
